data.name: Pro Birder
data.detailed_description:
At its core, Pro Birder is an arcade high-score game about being a bird. Fly fast, pull off tricks, and build up a score — then land clean to keep it. The map is designed to be filled with many different ways to increase your score, or lose it all to the cat in the bushes you didn't see.

Momentum-based flight built for flow: dive for speed, climb, tumble, and thread the gaps. Easy to pick up gameplay with a deep enough design to master like a professional birder.

⚠️PRO BIRDER DEVELOPMENT ⚠️

Pro Birder is currently in Pre-Alpha development, shipping into Early Access in October 2026. The game is being rapidly developed alongside community feedback and is still very open to design and directional changes.

SCORE & GROW

  • Tricks, stunts, and stylish flying build your score while you're in the air. Landing safely banks it. Crashing doesn't.

  • Catch food to grow, and work your way up to bigger birds — each one changes how you fly.

THE WORLD

  • A handcrafted lakeside cove to explore and master, full of wildlife that doesn't always have your best interests in mind.

PLAY TOGETHER

  • Fly solo, or host an online lobby and share the sky with friends.

LEADERBOARDS

  • Steam leaderboards at launch

⚡ FUTURE ROADMAP AFTER RELEASE⚡

  • More maps, more bird species, new mechanics & game modes, and other community requested features

Thanks for being apart of the development of Pro Birder — and be sure to wishlist the game on Steam to get notified about demos and Early Access opportunities.

data.short_description: An arcade high-score game about becoming a true Pro Birder. Fly, dive, and tumble your way through multiple bird species and fast-paced gameplay, dominating the open skies and ground beneath you. Play solo or host an online lobby with friends. Chase the leaderboards and become King of the Sky

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-Core (Intel i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 1070 / Radeon RX 5700 (6 GB+ VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: 6-Core (Intel i5-12400 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 3060 Ti / Radeon RX 6700 (8 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
